subdomains.name: Murder Subdomain (Death)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Death's Embrace with Killing Blow and replace the Death domain's 3rd-, 5th-, and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Bleeding Touch
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, cause a living creature to take 1d6 bleed damage each round for rounds equal to half cleric level. Healing or a DC 15 Heal check ends it. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Killing Blow
powers.summary: When you confirm a critical hit with a melee or ranged weapon, deal additional bleed damage equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Undead Subdomain (Death)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Bleeding Touch with Death's Kiss and replace the Death domain's 2nd-, 4th-, and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Death's Kiss
powers.summary: With a melee touch attack, make a creature count as undead for positive- and negative-energy healing and damage for rounds equal to half cleric level. This does not affect Turn Undead or Command Undead. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Death's Embrace
powers.summary: Negative energy channeled by the cleric heals the cleric instead of harming them; excess healing is not gained as temporary hit points.

subdomains.name: Catastrophe Subdomain (Destruction)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Destructive Aura with Deadly Weather and replace the Destruction domain's 2nd-, 3rd-, and 7th-level spells.

powers.name: Destructive Smite
powers.summary: Declare before a melee attack to gain a morale bonus on its damage roll equal to half cleric level, minimum +1. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Deadly Weather
powers.summary: Create a storm with a radius of 5 feet per cleric level for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Each round choose driving rain, howling winds, heavy snow, or a call lightning bolt; the same effect cannot occur in consecutive rounds.

subdomains.name: Rage Subdomain (Destruction)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Destructive Aura with Rage and replace the Destruction domain's 2nd- and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Destructive Smite
powers.summary: Declare before a melee attack to gain a morale bonus on its damage roll equal to half cleric level, minimum +1. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Rage
powers.summary: Rage as a barbarian for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Select one rage power at 12th and 16th level, using half cleric level as barbarian level; powers with level requirements are unavailable.
